items.title: Flash-Next's exact projection suite holds on whatever card memory its round is given, or the placement that flips it is named

steps.title: Flash-Next's exact projection suite holds on whatever card memory its round is given, or the placement that flips it is named
steps.rationale:
Note: Observed in the measurement at 3a7b3877d: Qwen3.8 Flash Next's projection-proof failed its exact suite on case "image-1-bottom", one token generated, " D" where the suite holds "D" (dataset-shard 1aea56cf9011), the only cell of 103 that failed. A labelled hypothesis, to be measured first: the run kept the card quiet, Flash-Next's experts fill the card memory the round leaves free (its peak rose 334 MB, flashnext-peak-capacity), more experts ran on the card than in the reading the suite was pinned beside, and the card's and the host's expert products differ enough to flip a near tie at the first token. The first step reads the cell again alone on a quiet card and records which experts the round held where, so the cause is named before any change: an exact suite that a placement flips is a check that depends on the card's free memory, and a path that answers otherwise on the card is a defect of the round.

Check: the projection-proof cell of Qwen3.8 Flash Next, measured alone, passes, or its failure is named with the round's expert placement.

decisions.question: skill.md's 227 rule lines each cite a check. Read at 3ba4de8c7: the first check of 181 has a doc comment and of 45 has none, and the comments state what their test holds, not the rule that cites it ("purpose = recursive self-improvement ..." cites TestCycleFilesDeclinesAndAcceptsNothing, whose comment is the cycle's comparisons; "scorecard columns = ..." cites TestScorecardRowsEveryServableModel, whose comment is rows and dashes). Writing skill.md from the comments as they stand changes what it says. Which form does skill.md take?
options: Each rule line moves onto its first check as a doc-comment line of its own, and skill.md is generated from those lines and its judgement section, so it says what it says now, each rule written once on its check
skill.md holds its terms and judgement lines alone; the rule lines go, each check saying its rule when it refuses
skill.md is written from the tests' doc comments as they stand, its wording changing to theirs
decisions.recommendation: Each rule line moves onto its first check as a doc-comment line of its own, and skill.md is generated from those lines and its judgement section, so it says what it says now, each rule written once on its check
